title: AI Focus Created Market Complacency: McLennan
summary: Matt McLennan, First Eagle Investments Head of Global Value Team, joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the market complacency created by a high concentration in AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Google Loses Bid to Block UK Class Action Over Search Ads
summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google must face a class action lawsuit over alleged abuse of its dominance after an antitrust tribunal allowed a claim on behalf of hundreds of thousands of British firms to go ahead.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic Model Tests Reveal More ‘Unsanctioned’ Actions
summary: Artificial intelligence models developed by OpenAI and Anthropic PBC carried out “unsanctioned” actions — including hacking a website and attempting to inject harmful code into software during safety testing — reinforcing fears that neither the creators nor seasoned researchers of these systems can predict their actions in testing. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Parmy Olson joins Francine Lacqua on "The Pulse" to discuss the implications. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Shopify Shares Soar as Revenue Outlook Beats Estimates
summary: Shopify Inc. shares rose as much as 33.8% in premarket trading after its third-quarter revenue outlook beat expectations.

title: Capex Is Only Way to Musk’s AI Vision for SpaceX, Says Dan Ives
summary: Dan Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville Ives & Co., examines the first quarterly report from SpaceX as the company disclosed higher-than-expected spending on its artificial intelligence business. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Chatbots Seen in Survey as More Trustworthy Than Politicians
summary: Survey finds people view chatbots as providing more accurate, useful information than local leaders

title: Circle Shares Jump as Company Boosts Outlook for Arc Blockchain
summary: Circle Internet Group Inc. shares jumped in premarket trading after the biggest US stablecoin issuer boosted the revenue outlook for its Arc blockchain payments offering.

title: Uber Gives In-Line Outlook, Says Brazil Rivals Hurt Trips Growth
summary: Uber Technologies Inc. issued a bookings outlook that just met analyst estimates and said fierce competition in the key Brazil market weighed on trips volume, compounding concerns from investors about the company’s ability to evolve in the robotaxi era.

title: Bezos, Arnault, Premji Pour Money Into AI Humanoid Robot Startups
summary: Family offices are particularly well-positioned to make these wagers.

title: Stocks Hit Records on AI Trade, Iran Deal Prospect | The Opening Trade 8/5/2026
summary:
Global stocks climbed to a record as hopes rose for a US-Iran deal to open the Strait of Hormuz, while investors renewed bets on the artificial intelligence trade, driving gains in chipmakers.

S&P 500 futures rose after the index hit another all-time high, buoyed by a rally in technology stocks. Europe’s Stoxx 600 hit a new record, as did MSCI’s All Country World Index.

Brent crude held around $80 a barrel after Tuesday’s plunge, as Axios reported that Washington, Tehran and Oman were nearing an agreement to resume oil flows through the Strait. Treasuries were steady and gold advanced as traders curbed expectations for interest-rate hikes.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards and Lizzy Burden. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Yann LeCun Joins New AI Investing Firm 224 Ventures
summary: Meta Platforms Inc.’s former chief AI scientist Yann LeCun, often called one of the “godfathers of AI,” is joining a new venture firm to invest in artificial intelligence startups.

title: Hyperscaler Debt Risks Europe’s Allure Morgan Stanley IM Says
summary: European investment-grade credit’s relative appeal over the US would diminish if the region absorbs a lot more bond issuance from hyperscalers, according to a Morgan Stanley Investment Management Inc. strategist.

title: Shein Is Said to Plan Gauging Investor Demand for Hong Kong IPO
summary: Fast-fashion retailer Shein Global Holdings Ltd. is planning to start gauging investor demand for its Hong Kong initial public offering as soon as this week, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Sandisk Earnings Give Dip Buyers an Opening After Stock’s Plunge
summary: Sandisk Corp.’s high flying stock tumbled back to Earth last month. Its earnings after the market closes Wednesday will test whether strong results are enough to entice investors to buy in again.

title: EQT-Run Scaleup Europe Fund Invests in Satellite Startup Iceye
summary: Europe’s new €5 billion ($5.8 billion) technology fund has disclosed that its first investment is in Finnish satellite company Iceye Oy, part of the bloc’s push to cultivate startups working on strategic technologies.

title: US Ban on Chinese Optical Parts Hurts Hyperscalers, Report Says
summary: A potential ban on the import of Chinese optical transceiver modules into the US would inflict collateral damage on US hyperscalers, exacerbating a supply bottleneck that no American firm can ease, research firm Counterpoint warned on Wednesday.

title: Taiyo Yuden Raises Earnings Forecast, Capex Plans on AI Demand
summary: Taiyo Yuden Co., a maker of a key component used in AI data centers, boosted its full-year earnings outlook by 50% to above estimates and said it’s speeding up production capacity expansion plans to meet accelerating demand.

title: AMD Slides After AI Growth Outlook Underwhelms Investors
summary: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. tumbled in early trading after giving an underwhelming sales outlook, a sign shareholders expected more of a return from the global expansion of AI data centers.

title: Australia Doubles Down on Data Centers Using Renewable Power
summary: Australia’s federal government will press on with a nationwide push to ensure new data centers use renewable energy, pledging to pass laws despite opposition to the move from some regional administrations.

title: Nvidia Partner Hon Hai’s Sales Rise 54% on Strong AI Demand
summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. reported a 54.2% increase in monthly sales, signaling sustained demand in global AI infrastructure buildout by customers such as Nvidia Corp.
